title: [Main]Cannot Rename User Due to Financial Report Audit Log Permissions - Copy
summary: User Management now correctly updates Financial Report Audit Log entries when a user is renamed, ensuring audit records reflect the new user name instead of keeping obsolete references.
key_points: Financial Report Audit Log table was missing from user-renaming logic
Added table to user-renaming handler in User Management codeunit
Granted required modify and rename permissions for the audit log table
Audit log entries now update with new user name when user is renamed
Added test to verify the audit log update behavior
quote: Added the table to the user-renaming handler and granted the required modify/rename permissions.
